annotation.description: The video shows an older man on the left side. You can only see his head, one hand and part of his upper body. He has shorter grayish/white hair and a shorter beard. He wears a green jacket. He touches the mouth of a light brown horse with grey horse halter which is fixed somewhere with a white rope. There is only the lower part of the horse head in the video.
